job.style: Use the attached design board as the STRICT style reference for palette and mood: modern clean semi-flat editorial illustration, soft rounded shapes, gentle soft shading, palette of deep navy #1F2A44, coral #F2643D, mint #2BB59A, warm light background #FAF7F2, white, warm natural skin tones. Calm, friendly, professional retail store atmosphere (clothing and home goods). No text, no letters, no logos, no signs, no labels anywhere in the image.
job.style_qa: современная полуплоская (semi-flat) редакционная иллюстрация в палитре борда (тёмно-синий/коралл/мятный/тёплый светлый фон), НЕ фото
job.person_note: The store administrator must resemble the woman in the attached photo (light-brown shoulder-length hair, dark navy polo shirt) but drawn in the illustration style, not as a photo; her badge has no text.
job.meaning: возврат без конфликта: администратор магазина спокойно и доброжелательно разговаривает у кассы с покупателем, который вернулся с пакетом (в пакете сложенный свитер)
job.prompt: At a light wooden cash desk of a bright clothing and home goods store, a friendly woman store administrator in a dark navy polo shirt calmly listens with a warm smile to a customer — a man of about 40 in a casual jacket — who has come back holding an open paper shopping bag with a neatly folded sweater inside. Relaxed open body language on both sides, no tension. Shelves with folded textiles and plants softly in the background. Medium shot, both people fully visible from the waist up, generous empty light area around them.
